name: Uchi ni Tomete yo ♪ ~Bitch na JK to Hame Makuri Dousei Seikatsu~
original_name: ウチに泊めてよ♪　～ビッチなJKとハメまくり同棲性活～
source:
Shibata Gorou is a man in his 30s who has no girlfriend. He's just a janitor, and his life has been dull with no excitement or romance. One day, he encounters a high school girl named Sakuragi Rumina, who is known for her promiscuity at the school where Gorou works. Rumina asks Gorou to let her stay at his place, promising to make it worth his while.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk009/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
柴田五郎是一个30多岁的男人，没有女朋友。他只是一个看门人，生活平淡无奇，没有激情，也没有浪漫。有一天，他在五郎工作的学校遇到了一位名叫樱木留美奈的高中女生，她以乱交而闻名。鲁米娜请求五郎让她留在他的住处，并承诺让他值得这么做。

[来自[url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk009/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
